name: tilemil_oauthc_adapt
description: Attention-MIL (ABMIL) on tumor CONCH bags with OAUTHC-specific few-shot adaptation: a good-site-trained head is fine-tuned on held-out OAUTHC support patients and evaluated on the rest of OAUTHC. Primary score is a full-cohort 5-fold OOF where OAUTHC test patients get within-fold OAUTHC adaptation. Reports the OAUTHC K-shot adaptation curve. Frozen features; no external data.

score_columns.name: p_msih
score_columns.description: fold OOF p(MSI-H); OAUTHC adapted on OAUTHC support
